name: Shadowfall deals periodic damage instead of nothing
contract: Shadowfall 284650 triggers 284652 every 1000ms for 8000ms. 284652 is SPELL_EFFECT_DUMMY with no registered
SpellScript, so each tick is a dispatched no-op (EffectBasePoints[0] = 982678, which with EffectDieSides[0] = 1
resolves at runtime to 982679 via the standard +1 roll formula). 982679 is a fully-authored SCHOOL_DAMAGE spell
(Shadow/Arcane) that triggers its own explosion 982681 - an unused, self-consistent chain, mirroring the native
vanilla Starfall dummy/damage pattern already used elsewhere in this codebase (spell_dru_starfall_dummy).
Registering a SpellScript for 284652 that casts GetEffectValue() on up to two random, LOS-visible nearby
enemies wires the existing chain back up. Expected: casting Shadowfall damages nearby enemies via 982679/982681
instead of doing nothing, and still grants Shadow Trance (17941) via the already-native 8s trigger.
